theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure holds the top attention rank and is the only theme with leadership cohesion plus the trend gate's staying-power support. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.59), breadth is healthy at 0.708, and the absolute-trend gate is validated as the one drawdown-control leg — favouring continued participation in the leader rather than a fade. Conviction stays low because rank-IC is ~0 and the headline val_state is 'fading'.
